verdict.rationale: Devin ships a documented public API (docs.devin.ai/api-reference/overview) explicitly for integrating Devin into applications and automating workflows, including advanced features like creating sessions on behalf of other users, plus an MCP server exposing session/playbook/schedule management to programmatic clients. Missing for 10: no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration of API usage.
